title: ArgSpec: entry points declare their own args; one parser rejects, helps, passes through
premise_notes: On fec367bf: boot/arena_args.gd:10-15 stores every arg (holds); boot/boot.gd:9-10 only Log.warns (holds); city_bench.gd:56-60 own KNOWN_FLAGS + quit(2) (holds); rig_bench_run.gd:8 re-lists --view (holds); metrics.mjs:70-82 counts reads, CMDLINE_ALLOW exempts launch_args.gd + arena_args.gd. Reran: 90 raw reads in 87 dev files, 66 with quit(2), 20 with neither quit(2) nor "unknown" - all reproduce; baseline direct_cmdline_reads total 157 reproduces. Small slips: baseline holds 90 (not 87) dev reads; dev/noir/showcase_args.gd has 0 raw reads, so "each drops its raw read" is false for it (the 10 reads in the other 9 files still give 157 -> 147). FRICTION lines perf:117, hud:48, handheld:656 hold.
floor_notes: M, effort 6, impact 8, risk 5, 15 files (at the cap), 8 cases, gate architecture. Floors pass on paper.

axis_notes.ambition: A parser migration over 11 entry points; solid, but the move is the rejected one with owner/expiry removed.
axis_notes.grounding: Counts reproduce; two small miscounts (87 vs 90 dev reads in baseline, showcase_args.gd has no raw read).
axis_notes.falsifiability: Exact error strings, exit codes and the 157 -> <=147 ratchet would catch a lax parser.

reason: On substance this is flag-registry again: same evidence (ArenaArgs accepts anything - the same file the rejected direction cited as dev/arena/arena_args.gd:10 - boot.gd warns only, the direct cmdline-read count) and the same cure (every entry declares its flags, undeclared ones are rejected, ArenaArgs gets one const of its 41 flags); dropping owner+expiry and saying "not a registry" twice does not change the direction the owner turned down.

title: tools/dev/run.mjs: one front door for dev entries with a pre-flight and a verdict line
premise_notes: FRICTION lines chars:21/234/304, hud:50/165/1294, rivet:175/388/707 checked: all describe the missing arena scene / stray -- / short --quit-after as claimed. boot.gd:10 warn-only holds. godot.mjs:19 SCRIPT_ERROR; only run_unit.mjs (104,150) and perf/ab.mjs (112) use it - holds (11 non-lib godot.mjs importers, roughly the "10 callers"). selftest/run.mjs:62 and :91 are bare awaits while :29 and :108 keep res - holds. reel_director.gd:54-58 length() already sums chapter ticks - holds. calls/REPORT.md:42 hand-writes "0 SCRIPT ERROR" - holds.
floor_notes: L, effort 7, impact 8, risk 5, 12 files, 8 cases, gate none. Size is honest.

axis_notes.ambition: A real front door plus a shared verdict library that also fixes the selftest exit-status hole; a good tooling move, not a leap.
axis_notes.grounding: Every cited line holds, but the flag pre-flight relies on "card A ArgSpec const, else a KNOWN list"; the real arena entry (boot/arena_args.gd) has neither, only a comment.
axis_notes.falsifiability: The verdict and selftest cases are tight; case 2 runs only on a fixture spec, so an implementation that refuses or silently passes every flag on the real arena (no declared spec) still passes.

revision: Replace case 2 with: entries.resolve("arena") on the real tree (boot/arena_args.gd declares no spec) -> pre-flight does no flag check, the launch proceeds and the verdict line says "flags unchecked: no declared spec"; a fixture with a declared KNOWN_FLAGS const and --bto -> exit 2 with the did-you-mean (no dependency on the voided ArgSpec card, no flag catalogue).
reason: Well grounded and valuable (scene resolution, derived --quit-after, one verdict line, selftest exit codes); only the flag pre-flight has to stop leaning on the voided ArgSpec card.

title: Evidence scope module: inert docs/evidence dirt and commits stop staling evidence
premise_notes: run.mjs:35-39 refuses any porcelain line, :41 keys on HEAD, :63-67 fails unit-tests on any churn, header :9 "PoF treats evidence from another commit as stale" - all hold. repo.mjs:42 dirtyLines is raw porcelain - holds. metrics.mjs:52 reads justfile + AGENTS.md - holds. Reran the classification: 3343 of 5513 non-merge commits since 2026-11-02 are docs/evidence/root JOURNAL/REPORT-only = 60.6% (card says 5520; same 3343 and 60.6%). git grep "tree changed during run" -- evidence = 13 files; the d9-seams log line is verbatim; --allow-dirty 67 hits in 18 lane docs reproduce. No tool or project/ code reads docs/ or evidence/ (only a comment in lint.mjs:105).
floor_notes: L, effort 6, impact 8, risk 6, 8 files, 8 cases, gate contract with an in-tree verifier (evidence.schema.json + the readersOfInert guard). Envelope shape and kind enum are unchanged. The dirty gate is narrowed, not loosened, for code paths.

axis_notes.ambition: Turns a prose belief about the inert set into a declared, guarded rule, and removes a 7-13 min re-run after a docs-only commit; a principal-level fix of the freshness model.
axis_notes.falsifiability: Carry/refuse cases are concrete, but carry keys only on the git diff and godotVersion: git-ignored inputs the kinds read (project/native/bin/ GDExtension, project/data/generated/city/ baked chunks) can change between A and HEAD with no commit, and a build that carries parity/bench over a rebuilt DLL passes every listed case.

revision: Add case: build/evidence/parity.json at A with an inert-only diff A..HEAD, but a git-ignored input newer than the envelope builtAt (a project/native/bin/*.dll or a project/data/generated/city/ chunk) -> no carry, the runner is called once.
reason: Strong, fully grounded card; the carry rule has to cover git-ignored inputs, or it re-stamps parity/bench evidence onto a native build it never measured.

title: cites: one command resolves every path a REPORT or decision line cites
premise_notes: decisions.md:137 cites `evidence/cop-gate.json`; git ls-files has only evidence/d5-cast/cop-gate.json - holds. calls/REPORT.md:11, vehicles/REPORT.md:3, d5-cast/REPORT.md:7 and :107, n-noir/REPORT.md:4 say what is claimed. Before "20/50": the grep the card quotes returns only 5 of 50 on this tree; a corrected pattern (every ... path ... checked) finds 21 reports with a genuine manual REPORT-phase path re-check, so the figure holds in substance but the stated command does not reproduce it. The 112/751 naive probe was not re-taken.
floor_notes: M, effort 5, impact 7, risk 4, 4 files, 7 cases, gate none. At the floor: a 2-file link checker is close to S; impact 7 is generous.

axis_notes.ambition: A citation link-checker for reports: useful hygiene, a tidy-up rather than a tooling move for the test/dev loop.
axis_notes.grounding: The core miss is real, but the quoted grep gives 5 not 20 (corrected: 21), and much of what the reports cite sits outside the repo (masters folders), which the tool can only mark UNCHECKED.
axis_notes.falsifiability: Status cases are crisp, but all run on fixtures; nothing pins the false-positive rate on the real tree, where an over-eager extractor would drown the one real miss.

revision: Add case: node tools/evidence/cites.mjs docs/decisions.md on the current tree -> exactly one MISSING (docs/decisions.md:137 evidence/cop-gate.json, did you mean evidence/d5-cast/cop-gate.json?) and exit 1, with no other MISSING line.
reason: Real but small; pin it to the actual tree so it ships with a known false-positive floor.

premise_notes: test_map.mjs:12 FULL_PREFIXES hand-list, :38 tests/** -> FULL "shared test code", :42 "no test mentions it", :60 text-mention only - all hold. boss_spec.gd:8 `res://data/tables/bosses.json`, street_walker_cards.gd:12 DIR constant, run_unit.mjs:73 FULL -> fastOnly(all), mutate.mjs:63 uses the same mapChanges and throws on FULL - hold. Reran the real mapChanges/realIndex over the last 600 non-merge commits: 157 project commits, 90 FULL (57%), mean 200.0 files of 346 - reproduces exactly. CLI: bosses.json -> FULL; sim_loop.gd -> 1 test (test_quest_objectives) while 7 other files name SimLoop - holds. No unit/integration test names a scenarios/golden/parity class or path, so the scenario rule is safe.
floor_notes: M, effort 6, impact 8, risk 5, 4 edited + 2 new files, 8 cases, gate architecture. M is honest (index + one-hop + --why + --history).

axis_notes.ambition: Fixes the selection model both --changed and mutation testing stand on, in both directions (fewer FULL fallbacks, and the under-selection of dependents closed); the move a principal engineer would make.
axis_notes.grounding: Every Before figure reproduced to the decimal.
axis_notes.falsifiability: Fixtures for tables, directory constants, dev/, one-hop and unreferenced assets would catch a wrong build; --history makes the 24% claim re-runnable.

reason: The strongest card: measured, reproducible, and it makes the inner loop both faster and more correct.

title: run_unit triage: cause, reach-from-your-diff verdict, rerun cmd per failure
premise_notes: junit.mjs:26 keeps only the first line - holds. gut.gd:625 "Unexpected Errors:\n" + errors and error_tracker.gd:157 "<type>code" - hold. run_unit.mjs:186-190 prints FAIL digest + a log pointer - holds; parseArgs at :35 has no --failed - holds. build/test-results/unit-tests.log is 5321 lines / 205143 bytes, and lines 4375-4378 show the test header with its ERROR and at: under it - holds. vehicles/JOURNAL.md:284 6 FAILED "Unexpected Errors" - holds.
floor_notes: M, effort 5, impact 7, risk 4, 5 edited + 2 new files, 8 cases, gate none. Honest M.

axis_notes.ambition: Good agent-UX work on red runs (cause lines, --failed, triage json); the reach verdict is the ambitious part.
axis_notes.falsifiability: The verdict case relies on a .gdshader reaching a test through vehicle_view.gd, which the current text-mention test_map cannot do (it maps that to FULL). Card test-suite A measures 5,945 missed dependent edges, so an UNREACHED "suspect the base or the machine" verdict built on the current map will tell agents real regressions are not theirs, and no case catches that.

revision: Add case: changed=[project/core/clock/sim_loop.gd] with a failure in a test that reaches SimLoop only through a dependent (or any change that maps FULL) -> verdict is never "UNREACHED ... suspect the base or the machine" (print REACHED via the one-hop index from test-suite A, or "UNMAPPED: the map is not exhaustive"); build it after test-suite A.
reason: Useful and grounded, but its "not yours" verdict is only safe on a map that finds dependents, so it needs a guard case and has to land after test-suite A.
